description: Keysmith claim chains: presentations a gating provider must serve or refuse. Every case is the output of verifyPresentation() from @filoz/keysmith. These vectors were produced by this implementation (FIP-1253 draft), so they pin it against change rather than independently confirm it. They are what Curio and other implementations test against. The private keys are the well-known Anvil/Hardhat development keys: public, never for anything of value. Byte strings are 0x-prefixed lowercase hex; integers too large for JSON are decimal strings.

types.ReadGrant: ReadGrant(uint8 v,string node,address owner,bytes16 groupKeyId,address bearer,uint8 maxDepth,uint256 chainId,bytes16 keyCommitment,bytes16 groupKeyCommitment,uint64 expires)
